title: S05T03 - Connect spec deltas, archive, supersession, and impact tracing
description: Preserve the transition from proposed delta to accepted current truth, link archive events to decisions and verified work, and calculate downstream impact when specifications change.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive or supersession retains the original proposal, design, delta, work, evidence, decision, and resulting current-spec hashes.
Impact tracing identifies open or closed work whose acceptance criteria or decisions depend on changed specification sections.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
